parameters.content:
# Ahoj: clips in, promo out
Three webhooks the website calls, in this order:

**A. POST /style** reads the editing style of a reference YouTube video.  
**B. POST /promo** plans the edit, composes music and starts the render.  
**C. GET /promo-status** tells the website when the video is ready.

n8n never touches video files. It passes links between Cloudinary (storage), Claude (editor), ElevenLabs (music) and Shotstack (renderer).

## A1. A reference video arrives
The website sends a YouTube link. We check it and write the brief for Gemini.

## A2. Gemini watches the reference
Returns a style profile: shot length, pacing, tempo (BPM), music genre, colour, text usage. If it takes over 70 seconds, we fall back to a default style.

## B1. Clips arrive
Brand details, the style profile and Cloudinary links to the clips. We turn each clip into still frames by changing its URL.

## B2. AI director
Claude sees the frames, works out the story, picks the shots and writes the copy.

## B3. Music
ElevenLabs composes a track in the reference's genre and tempo. Cloudinary hosts it.

## B4. Edit and render
The plan becomes a cut list: shots snapped to the beat, positioned text, end card, soundtrack. Shotstack starts rendering and we reply with a job id.

## C. Is it ready?
The website asks every 3 seconds. We ask Shotstack and pass back the status and, when done, the video link.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jobId: $json.response.id, plan: $('Build cut list').first().json.plan, director: $('Build cut list').first().json.director, music: $('Build cut list').first().json.music }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $json.response.status === 'done' ? 'done' : ($json.response.status === 'failed' ? 'failed' : ($json.response.status === 'queued' ? 'queued' : 'rendering')), videoUrl: $json.response.url || null, error: $json.response.error || null }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const url = ($input.first().json.body || {}).referenceUrl || '';
if (!/^https?:\/\/(www\.|m\.)?(youtube\.com|youtu\.be)\//i.test(url)) throw new Error('referenceUrl must be a public YouTube link');
const prompt = [
  'You are a senior video editor. Watch this video closely, picture and sound, and write a precise brief of its EDITING STYLE so another editor can cut completely different footage to feel the same. Describe the craft, not the subject matter.',
  'Return only JSON with exactly these fields:',
  '{"summary": one sentence describing the edit,',
  ' "editorNotes": 6 to 9 sentences of concrete direction: how it opens, how shots are chosen and ordered, rhythm and where it speeds up or breathes, relationship of cuts to the music, camera movement and any speed changes or zooms, how and how often text appears, colour grade, how it ends,',
  ' "avgShotLength": average seconds per shot as a number,',
  ' "shotLengthRange": [shortest typical shot in seconds, longest typical shot in seconds],',
  ' "pacing": short phrase,',
  ' "cutStyle": short phrase, e.g. hard cuts on the beat, cross dissolves, whip pans,',
  ' "motion": short phrase about camera movement, zooms, speed ramps,',
  ' "textUsage": one of "none", "title only", "sparse", "every shot",',
  ' "captionStyle": short phrase describing on-screen text, or none,',
  ' "colorMood": short phrase,',
  ' "musicMood": short phrase,',
  ' "musicGenre": short phrase with instruments, e.g. cinematic electronic with piano and deep drums,',
  ' "bpm": estimated music tempo in beats per minute as a number,',
  ' "structure": short phrase,',
  ' "transition": "none" or "fade",',
  ' "captionCase": "upper" or "sentence",',
  ' "captionPosition": "top" or "center" or "bottom",',
  ' "filter": one of "none", "boost", "contrast", "muted", "greyscale"}'
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { request: { contents: [{ parts: [{ file_data: { file_uri: url }, video_metadata: { start_offset: '0s', end_offset: '90s' } }, { text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Instrumental soundtrack for a short promotional video. Genre and instruments: ' + (($('Clips arrive').first().json.body.style || {}).musicGenre || 'upbeat indie pop with guitar and claps') + '. Mood: ' + ((($('Clips arrive').first().json.body.style || {}).musicMood || '').match(/^(none|)$/i) ? 'feel-good, sunny road trip' : $('Clips arrive').first().json.body.style.musicMood) + '. Tempo exactly ' + ((Number(($('Clips arrive').first().json.body.style || {}).bpm) >= 60 && Number(($('Clips arrive').first().json.body.style || {}).bpm) <= 180) ? Number($('Clips arrive').first().json.body.style.bpm) : 120) + ' BPM with a clear, steady beat from the very first second. No vocals. Clean ending.', music_length_ms: (Math.min(60, Number($('Clips arrive').first().json.body.length) || 30) + 1) * 1000, force_instrumental: true }) }}
